faq.q: Does the Brentwood page cover all of Burnaby's Brentwood area, or just Brentwood Park?
faq.a: On the evidence of the live feed, it covers the Brentwood Park board sub-area: all 12 first-page cards are labelled "Brentwood Park," the feed showed 357 results, and the September 2026 board snapshot for Brentwood Park (21 detached / 360 attached listings) matches that scope in shape and scale (as of September 2026, Source: SnapStats FVR/GVR September 2026 report).

faq.q: How did Brentwood Park sell in September 2026?
faq.a: Detached: 21 listings, 3 sold, 14% (joint with The Crest). Condos & Townhomes: 360 listings — the largest attached inventory in Burnaby — with 39 sold, 11%. No sub-area median is published for Brentwood Park, and Burnaby's community medians (detached $1,825,000; attached $686,000) are not Brentwood Park figures (as of September 2026, Source: SnapStats FVR/GVR September 2026 report).

faq.q: What plan guides development in Brentwood?
faq.a: Brentwood is one of four Town Centres designated in Burnaby's Official Community Plan; the Brentwood Town Centre Development Plan (1996) is the community plan, and the Brentwood Site at Lougheed Highway and Willingdon Avenue is guided by the Brentwood Site Conceptual Master Plan adopted in 2013.

On the board snapshot, yes: 360 of Brentwood Park's 381 September 2026 listings (94%) were Condos & Townhomes, the largest attached shelf in Burnaby, against 21 detached listings; the live feed's first page matches that shape, with 11 of 12 cards attached (as of September 2026, Source: SnapStats FVR/GVR September 2026 report).
